title: Quantum ESPRESSO native constant-tau transport moments
bounded_subset: Fixed uniform k meshes; supplied band energies, Cartesian velocities, normalized k weights, cell volume, chemical-potential grid, temperature grid, and spin degeneracy; constant relaxation time; no Fourier interpolation, Hall tensor, or adaptive meshes.
input_contract: QE-style band energies and velocities, k weights, volume, chemical potentials, temperatures, spin degeneracy, and a fixed transport-DOS energy grid.
output_contract: Carrier count and density, L0/L1/L2, conductivity/tau, Seebeck, and electronic kappa/tau tensors.
candidate_interface: A new QE PP/src transport_moments implementation and command-line driver; candidate execution must not import, link, or execute BoltzTraP2.
reference_pipeline: Locked QE-style band data are evaluated by the unchanged locked BoltzTraP2 BTPDOS -> fermiintegrals -> calc_Onsager_coefficients pipeline.

verification.numeric_comparison: L0/L1/L2 and transport tensors relative 1e-6, with an absolute floor for empty-carrier windows.
scientific_invariants: Seebeck is invariant under a common constant-tau scaling
particle-hole symmetric bands have vanishing L1 at mu=0
permuting k points or bands does not change any aggregate
verification.fixtures: Parabolic bands, particle-hole symmetry, anisotropic and off-diagonal velocities, nonuniform integer k multiplicities, low/high temperature, spin factors, empty windows, and rank-deficient conductivity.

non_glue_reason: The implementation must build a transport DOS, integrate finite-temperature Fermi windows, form tensor moments, and derive coupled Onsager coefficients.
